name: Wi-Fi connectivity problems
description: Reviewers report the app fails to connect over Wi-Fi while mobile data works, and some song quality seems poor.

name: Login and password failures
description: Users report being unable to log into their accounts or having passwords rejected, alongside complaints about excessive ads.

name: Premium cost concerns
description: Reviewers feel the app has become premium-only to generate revenue for the company.

name: Features locked behind premium
description: Users say basic actions like choosing specific songs, skipping, and replaying parts are restricted to premium subscribers.

name: Missing songs and genres
description: Reviewers say the library lacks many songs and certain music genres, such as gospel.

name: Lyrics missing or inconsistent
description: Users report lyrics sometimes fail to appear, and availability differs unpredictably between songs.

name: Weaker song recommendations
description: A reviewer feels recommendations used to offer more songs and more recent releases than they do now.

name: Downloads get stuck
description: A user reports song downloads stalling indefinitely in the background.

name: Offline mode not working
description: A reviewer says the offline feature does not work as expected.

name: General negative sentiment
description: Reviewers express broad dissatisfaction with the app, often citing recent updates, without specifying a particular problem.

name: App crashes after update
description: A user reports the app crashing and becoming unopenable following a recent update.

name: General playback bugs
description: Users report songs not playing, voice assistant integration failing, and audio adjustment settings not working properly.

name: App stuck loading
description: A reviewer reports the app freezing on the loading or logo screen and never getting past it.

name: Playback stops unexpectedly
description: A user reports music repeatedly stopping midway and failing to resume where it left off.

name: Too many or loud ads
description: Reviewers complain about frequent ads interrupting songs, ads that are very loud, and limited ad-free listening for free users.

name: Home screen layout disliked
description: A user dislikes the new home screen design, finding the one-item-at-a-time scrolling layout cumbersome.

name: Shuffle and queue frustrations
description: Users report playlists playing songs randomly, limited skipping, and being unable to go back or easily play a single chosen song.

name: Blend feature requests
description: A reviewer praises the blend feature and requests the ability to rename blends, noting a recurring issue from years ago.
